mathematical_scope: Large exact finite-field regression driver for folded Galois Fourier and inverse residual at N=4096,8192,16384.
input_and_guard_coverage: All sizes and seeds are hard-coded. Guards are assertions delegated to the implementation. Under -O, equality assertions disappear but success JSON labels remain.
cost_and_scaling: Each case computes a folded transform, a whole-length radix2 comparator, another residual and its inverse; total O(N log N) field work and O(N) algorithmic storage plus cached roots. No independent timing/cost instrumentation.
test_evidence: Checks every output at the three configured instances and full inverse vector equality if assertions remain enabled. No run performed here. The reference fft_radix2 is the same helper used inside the candidate, so arithmetic/root/sign bugs can be shared.
dependency_identity: Assigned phase15_executor and haar_coherence exact hashes f2bc75914a3f… and 36437d50a2fb….

findings.finding: The label independent is only partially justified: the whole-length decomposition differs, but it reuses the same radix2 routine, field, phase tables and normalization machinery. It is not an independently implemented DFT oracle.

acceptance_boundary: Accept as intended larger regression coverage; success claims require an actual normal-mode run and independent small direct-DFT controls.
